tasks.title: Design governed bootstrap for accumulated legacy context drift
tasks.phase: Supervisor Runtime / Source-only Legacy Bootstrap Repair
acceptance: Reproduce the post-PR-4648 bootstrap state: the active mutable incumbent is an accepted dev ancestor, governed launch sources and index are clean, and the only unstaged tracked changes are task briefs accumulated before command-checkout materialization was prevented.

Design an explicit fail-closed transactional bootstrap or equivalent source path for already-accumulated provenance-verifiable generated context drift; do not reset, stash, checkout, edit, or otherwise clean the active mutable root and do not broadly ignore tracked drift.

Bind the exact incumbent PID/starttime/cwd/commit/tree/config bytes plus every drift path and byte digest before authority is granted; reject staged drift, index flags, non-task-brief paths, non-canonical or unprovable generated bytes, symlink/gitfile/Git identity hazards, unaccepted commits, and any post-capture drift race.

Preserve immutable candidate identity, governed launch-source byte capture, config CAS, intent-before-TERM ordering, exact-generation signalling, three fresh loop gates, authoritative-shadow catch-up, queue/worker parity, provider baseline, rollback, and bytecode self-rejection.

Prove the PR-4648 prevention boundary remains active so a newly launched immutable runtime does not regenerate task briefs in its command root; include focused negative tests and a committed pre-review evidence manifest.

Perform no live config edit, direct process signal, manual checkout/reset/stash, candidate deletion, runtime promotion, scheduling change, task-state governance change, or fleet-routing policy change; a later rollout retry remains a separately authorized governed task.
tasks.summary: After PR #4648 merged, the governed f5570754 retry still failed before mutation because the legacy mutable incumbent already contains four supervisor-generated task-brief overwrites. Implement only the source transaction boundary needed to bootstrap that accumulated historical context drift without weakening general tracked-tree cleanliness or touching live runtime.
